# Copilot Instructions

This repository is designed for AI‑assisted development using GitHub Copilot.

## Goals
- Maintain clean architecture
- Prefer TypeScript and functional React
- Use Redux Toolkit for state management
- Keep components small and reusable

## Copilot Rules
1. Prefer TypeScript over JavaScript
2. Avoid adding unnecessary dependencies
3. Follow folder structure strictly
4. Write reusable utilities
5. Separate UI and business logic

## Coding Style
- Functional components
- Hooks instead of classes
- Redux Toolkit slices
- Clear naming conventions

## Avoid
- Monolithic components
- Inline complex logic in JSX
- Unstructured state management
